newsitem.title: UK: Takeovers bring record year for UK law firms - paper.
newsitem.headline: Takeovers bring record year for UK law firms - paper.

text.p: British law firms reaped rich rewards from last year's boom in takeover activity earning record fees of around 300 million pounds ($510 million), a 50 percent increase from 1995 according to Acquisitions Monthly magazine.
Total fees paid out for mergers and acquisitions in Britain reached a record 1.1 billion pounds in 1996, it said.
The figure includes fees paid to investment bankers, lawyers, accountants and public relations advisers.
Among law firms, Linklaters & Paines took first place, advising on 19 deals worth 16.26 billion pounds.
Slaughter & May advised on 25 deals, the largest number, amounting to 16.26 billion pounds. ($1=.5904 Pound)
